#   FireHOL IP Blocklist › Level 3
#   
#   This blocklist is sourced from FireHOL and aggregates IP addresses
#   which provide maximum protection with minimum false positives. Suitable for
#   basic protection on all internet facing servers, routers and firewalls. 
#   
#   The objective is to create a blacklist that can be safe enough to be used
#   on all systems, with a firewall, to block access entirely, from and to its
#   listed IPs. 
#   
#   This blocklist includes the following IP lists:
#   
#   bruteforceblocker   IPs detected performing SSH bruteforce attacks.
#   ciarmy              Scoring system for IP addresses based on the volume and
#                       frequency of unwanted traffic.
#   dshield_30d         All IPs reported by dshield over the last 30 days.
#   myip                IPs identified as web bots, crawlers, and spammers.
#   vxvault             Latest malware hosting IPs. 
#   
#   This list casts a wider net than firehol_level2 and may include some false
#   positives, especially for IPs that were flagged weeks ago but may no longer
#   be malicious. 
#   
#   This third-party blocklist is not maintained by ConfigServer; IPs are
#   sourced externally and not curated by us. We do however, validate the
#   blocklist to ensure that it only contains properly validated IP addresses,
#   and does not include any non-relevant or malformed data beyond the scope
#   of the source.
#   
#   Use at the administrator’s discretion based on risk tolerance and
#   environment requirements.
